using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using Azure.Core;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Hashbrown.Conformance.Integration;
using Hashbrown.Conformance.Testing;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

var messages = new[] { new ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, "hello") };
var state = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
using var inner = new ProbeClient();
using var subject = new FixtureLiveModelClient(inner, state);
var original = new ChatOptions { MaxOutputTokens = 900, Temperature = 0.9f, Tools = [AIFunctionFactory.Create(() => "ok", "lookupAirport")] };
await foreach (var _ in subject.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, original)) { }
Check(original.MaxOutputTokens == 900 && original.Temperature == 0.9f && original.Tools.Count == 1, "mutated caller options");
Check(inner.Options!.MaxOutputTokens == 384 && inner.Options.Temperature == 0 && inner.Options.ToolMode is NoneChatToolMode, "uncapped model options");
Check(state.Calls == 1 && state.Stage == "completed", "missing attempt count");
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in subject.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages)) { } }, "LIVE_CALL_CAP");
Check(inner.Calls == 1, "cap checked after native invocation");

var toolState = new FixtureLiveGate("browser-tool");
using var toolInner = new ProbeClient();
using var toolClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(toolInner, toolState);
await foreach (var _ in toolClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, original)) { }
Check(toolInner.Options!.ToolMode is RequiredChatToolMode required && required.RequiredFunctionName == "getWeather", "tool was not forced");
await foreach (var _ in toolClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync([.. messages, new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, [new FunctionCallContent("call_1", "getWeather", new Dictionary<string,object?> { ["city"] = "Paris" })]), new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("call_1", "{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":21,\"condition\":\"sunny\"}")])], original)) { }
Check(toolInner.Options!.ToolMode is NoneChatToolMode, "tool continuation was not disabled");

using var mixedState = new FixtureLiveGate("mixed-native-tools");
Check(mixedState.MaxCalls == 2, "native mixed cap changed");
mixedState.Dispatch(); mixedState.Dispatch();
await Reject(() => { mixedState.Dispatch(); return Task.CompletedTask; }, "LIVE_CALL_CAP");
Check(mixedState.Calls == 2, "native mixed cap exceeded");

var mixedCalls = new FunctionCallContent[] { new("b1", "getWeather", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["city"] = "Paris" }), new("s1", "lookupAirport", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "PDX" }) };
var mixedInput = new ChatMessage[] { new(ChatRole.User, "request") };
using var nativeMixedState = new FixtureLiveGate("mixed-native-tools");
using var nativeMixedInner = new MixedProbe(mixedCalls);
using var nativeMixedClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(nativeMixedInner, nativeMixedState);
await foreach(var _ in nativeMixedClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(mixedInput)) { }
if (nativeMixedInner.Options?.AllowMultipleToolCalls != true || nativeMixedInner.Options.ToolMode is not RequiredChatToolMode { RequiredFunctionName: null }) throw new Exception("mixed choice not required");
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in nativeMixedClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync([.. mixedInput, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [.. mixedCalls]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("b1", "{\"city\":\"Paris\"}")])])) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
Check(nativeMixedState.Calls == 1, "incomplete native history acquired model work");
var nativeWeather = "{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":21,\"condition\":\"sunny\"}";
var nativeAirport = "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"Portland International Airport\"}";
foreach (var (weatherResult, airportResult) in new[] {
    ("{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":999,\"condition\":\"sunny\"}", nativeAirport),
    ("{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":21}", nativeAirport),
    ("{\"city\":\"Paris\",\"temperatureC\":21,\"condition\":\"sunny\",\"extra\":true}", nativeAirport),
    (nativeWeather, "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"Wrong Airport\"}"),
    (nativeWeather, "{\"code\":\"PDX\"}"),
    (nativeWeather, "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"Portland International Airport\",\"extra\":true}") })
{
    await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in nativeMixedClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync([.. mixedInput, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [.. mixedCalls]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("b1", weatherResult), new FunctionResultContent("s1", airportResult)])])) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
    Check(nativeMixedState.Calls == 1, "changed native result acquired model work");
}
await foreach(var _ in nativeMixedClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync([..mixedInput,new(ChatRole.Assistant,[..mixedCalls]),new(ChatRole.Tool,[new FunctionResultContent("b1",nativeWeather),new FunctionResultContent("s1",nativeAirport)])])) { }
var nativeMixedStats = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(nativeMixedState.Snapshot());
if(nativeMixedState.Calls != 2 || !nativeMixedStats.GetProperty("nativeCoEmission").GetBoolean() || !nativeMixedStats.GetProperty("nativeExactHistory").GetBoolean()) throw new Exception("missing proof");
try { await foreach(var _ in nativeMixedClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(mixedInput)) {} throw new Exception("cap absent"); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
using var sequential = new FixtureLiveGate("mixed-native-tools");
using var sequentialClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new MixedProbe([mixedCalls[0]]),sequential);
try { await foreach(var _ in sequentialClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(mixedInput)) {} throw new Exception("sequential fallback accepted"); } catch(InvalidOperationException e) when(e.Message == "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID") {}

var invalidHistory = new FixtureLiveGate("browser-tool");
using var invalidClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new ProbeClient(), invalidHistory);
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in invalidClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync([.. messages, new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("unowned", "secret-canary")])], original)) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");

using (var expired = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema", TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(10)))
{
    await Task.Delay(30);
    using var expiredClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new ProbeClient(), expired);
    await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in expiredClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages)) { } }, "LIVE_CANCELLED");
    Check(expired.Calls == 0, "expired request acquired credentials");
}

var streamState = new FixtureLiveGate("streaming-plain");
using var streamInner = new ProbeClient();
using var streamClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(streamInner, streamState);
await using (var iterator = streamClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages).GetAsyncEnumerator())
{
    Check(await iterator.MoveNextAsync() && iterator.Current.Text == "native-text", "gate hid first update");
    var next = iterator.MoveNextAsync().AsTask();
    await Task.Delay(30);
    Check(!next.IsCompleted && streamState.Stage == "paused", "gate did not pause actual iterator");
    streamState.Release();
    Check(!await next, "gate synthesized output");
}

var cancelState = new FixtureLiveGate("cancellation-recovery");
using var cancelInner = new ProbeClient();
using var cancelClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(cancelInner, cancelState);
using (var cancel = new CancellationTokenSource())
{
    await using var iterator = cancelClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, cancellationToken: cancel.Token).GetAsyncEnumerator();
    Check(await iterator.MoveNextAsync(), "missing actual update before cancel");
    var next = iterator.MoveNextAsync().AsTask();
    cancel.Cancel();
    await Reject(async () => await next, "LIVE_CANCELLED");
}
Check(cancelState.CancelledCalls == 1 && cancelInner.DisposedIterators == 1, "native iterator not cancelled and disposed");
await foreach (var _ in cancelClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages)) { }
Check(cancelState.Calls == 2 && cancelState.Stage == "completed", "fresh request failed after cancel");

var failureState = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
using var failureClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new ProbeClient { Fail = true }, failureState);
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in failureClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages)) { } }, "LIVE_PROVIDER_FAILED");

// Native SDK generates the actual HTTPS request; only the unit transport is substituted.
var wireState = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
var transport = new NativeHandler();
using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveHttpHandler(wireState, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string,string?> {
    ["Provider"] = "openai", ["ModelApi"] = "responses", ["Model"] = "gpt-4.1-mini", ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://api.openai.com/v1/", ["ApiKey"] = "secret-canary"
}).Build();
using var native = ProviderFactory.Create(configuration, new ProviderClientComposition(auth => auth.CreateCredential(), http));
var response = await native.GetResponseAsync(messages, new ChatOptions { MaxOutputTokens = 384, Temperature = 0 });
Check(response.Text == "ok", "native SDK response failed");
Check(transport.Calls == 1 && wireState.HttpCalls == 1, "wire missing");
var facts = JsonSerializer.Serialize(wireState.Snapshot());
Check(facts.Contains("384") && !facts.Contains("secret-canary") && !facts.Contains("hello"), "unsafe or missing wire facts");
using var rejected = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses") { Content = new StringContent("{\"model\":\"gpt-4.1-mini\",\"max_output_tokens\":385,\"store\":false}") };
await Reject(async () => await http.SendAsync(rejected), "LIVE_WIRE_INVALID");
Check(transport.Calls == 1, "unsafe native request dispatched");
var actualState = new FixtureLiveGate("cancellation-recovery");
var actualTransport = new NativeHandler();
using var actualHttp = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveHttpHandler(actualState, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", actualTransport));
using var actualNative = new FixtureLiveModelClient(ProviderFactory.Create(configuration, new ProviderClientComposition(auth => auth.CreateCredential(), actualHttp)), actualState);
using (var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource())
{
    await using var iterator = actualNative.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, cancellationToken: cancellation.Token).GetAsyncEnumerator();
    var sawText = false;
    while (await iterator.MoveNextAsync()) if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(iterator.Current.Text)) { sawText = true; break; }
    Check(sawText, "actual SDK produced no text");
    var pending = iterator.MoveNextAsync().AsTask();
    await Task.Delay(30);
    Check(!pending.IsCompleted && actualState.Stage == "paused", "actual SDK gate not reached");
    cancellation.Cancel();
    await Reject(async () => await pending, "LIVE_CANCELLED");
}
Check(actualState.CancelledCalls == 1 && actualTransport.StreamDisposed, "actual SDK iterator not cancelled and disposed");
await foreach (var _ in actualNative.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages)) { }
Check(actualState.Calls == 2 && actualState.HttpCalls == 2 && actualState.Stage == "completed", "actual SDK failed fresh recovery");

var nonstreamState = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
using var nonstreamClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new ProbeClient(), nonstreamState);
var nonstream = await nonstreamClient.GetResponseAsync(messages, original);
Check(nonstream.Text == "native-text" && nonstreamState.Calls == 1, "nonstream bypassed native policy");
using (var disposalClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(new DisposeFailureClient(), new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema")))
{
    var iterator = disposalClient.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages).GetAsyncEnumerator();
    Check(await iterator.MoveNextAsync(), "missing disposal probe update");
    await Reject(async () => await iterator.DisposeAsync(), "LIVE_PROVIDER_FAILED");
}

var acquisitionState = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
var credential = new BudgetCredential(() => acquisitionState.Calls);
var azure = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string,string?> {
    ["Provider"] = "azure", ["ModelApi"] = "responses", ["Model"] = "gpt-4.1-mini", ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://native-unit.invalid/", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli"
}).Build();
var acquisitionTransport = new NativeHandler();
using var acquisitionHttp = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveHttpHandler(acquisitionState, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", acquisitionTransport));
using var acquisitionClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(ProviderFactory.Create(azure, new ProviderClientComposition(_ => credential, acquisitionHttp)), acquisitionState);
await Reject(async () => await acquisitionClient.GetResponseAsync(messages), "LIVE_PROVIDER_FAILED");
Check(credential.Calls == 1 && credential.CountedFirst && acquisitionState.Calls == 1 && acquisitionTransport.Calls == 0, "failed native acquisition was not counted before acquisition");
await Reject(async () => await acquisitionClient.GetResponseAsync(messages), "LIVE_CALL_CAP");
Check(credential.Calls == 1, "exhausted native reservation reacquired credentials");
var redirectState = new FixtureLiveGate("structured-schema");
using var redirectAudit = new FixtureLiveHttpHandler(redirectState, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses");
Check(redirectAudit.InnerHandler is HttpClientHandler configuredHandler && !configuredHandler.AllowAutoRedirect, "redirects can bypass audited dispatches");
redirectAudit.InnerHandler = new RedirectLoopback(redirectAudit.InnerHandler!, new Uri(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("LIVE_REDIRECT_LOOPBACK")!));
using var redirectHttp = new HttpClient(redirectAudit);
using var redirectClient = new FixtureLiveModelClient(ProviderFactory.Create(configuration, new ProviderClientComposition(auth => auth.CreateCredential(), redirectHttp)), redirectState);
await Reject(async () => await redirectClient.GetResponseAsync(messages), "LIVE_PROVIDER_FAILED");
Check(redirectState.Calls == 1 && redirectState.HttpCalls == 1, "redirect retried native dispatch");

// Deterministic probes below are policy/accounting tests, never genuine live approval evidence.
using var nativeApprovalCap = new FixtureLiveGate("native-approval");
Check(nativeApprovalCap.MaxCalls == 4, "native approval reservation changed");
for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++) nativeApprovalCap.Dispatch();
await Reject(() => { nativeApprovalCap.Dispatch(); return Task.CompletedTask; }, "LIVE_CALL_CAP");
Check(nativeApprovalCap.Calls == 4, "native fifth attempt counted");

var protectedArguments = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "PDX" };
using var approvalPolicyState = new FixtureLiveGate("native-approval");
using var approvalProbe = new ApprovalProbe();
using var approvalPolicy = new FixtureLiveModelClient(approvalProbe, approvalPolicyState);
var protectedOptions = new ChatOptions { MaxOutputTokens = 900, AllowMultipleToolCalls = true, Tools = [AIFunctionFactory.Create(() => "unit only", "lookupAirport")] };
await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, protectedOptions)) { }
Check(approvalProbe.Options!.ToolMode is RequiredChatToolMode { RequiredFunctionName: "lookupAirport" } && approvalProbe.Options.MaxOutputTokens == 384 && approvalProbe.Options.AllowMultipleToolCalls == false, "native approval initial policy absent");
Check(protectedOptions.MaxOutputTokens == 900 && protectedOptions.ToolMode is null && protectedOptions.AllowMultipleToolCalls == true, "native approval mutated options");
var protectedCall = new FunctionCallContent("protected-model-call", "lookupAirport", protectedArguments);
var protectedOutput = new FunctionResultContent("protected-model-call", "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"Portland International Airport\"}");
ChatMessage[] protectedHistory = [ ..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [protectedOutput])];
foreach (var bad in new ChatMessage[][] {
    messages,
    [..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall])],
    [..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [new FunctionCallContent("other", "lookupAirport", protectedArguments)]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [protectedOutput])],
    [..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("protected-model-call", "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"wrong\"}")])],
    [..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall, protectedCall]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [protectedOutput])]
}) {
    await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync(bad, protectedOptions)) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
    Check(approvalProbe.Calls == 1, "wrong approval continuation reached native client");
}
await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync(protectedHistory, protectedOptions)) { }
Check(approvalProbe.Options!.ToolMode is NoneChatToolMode, "native approval continuation allowed a tool");
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync(protectedHistory, protectedOptions)) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
Check(approvalProbe.Calls == 2, "stale followup reused old model iterator");
ChatMessage[] changedLaterHistory = [ ..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [new FunctionResultContent("protected-model-call", "{\"code\":\"PDX\",\"name\":\"wrong\"}")]), new(ChatRole.Assistant, "done"), new(ChatRole.User, "later plain user")];
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync(changedLaterHistory, protectedOptions)) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
Check(approvalProbe.Calls == 2, "changed third-turn result acquired model work");
var rehydratedResult = new FunctionResultContent("protected-model-call", JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { name = "Portland International Airport", code = "PDX" }));
ChatMessage[] rehydratedHistory = [ ..messages, new(ChatRole.Assistant, [protectedCall]), new(ChatRole.Tool, [rehydratedResult])];
await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync([..rehydratedHistory, new(ChatRole.Assistant, "done"), new(ChatRole.User, "later plain user")], protectedOptions)) { }
var approvalStats = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(approvalPolicyState.Snapshot());
Check(approvalProbe.Calls == 3 && approvalStats.GetProperty("usageCompleteCalls").GetInt32() == 3 && approvalStats.GetProperty("usageIncompleteCalls").GetInt32() == 0, "native three phase usage missing");
Check(approvalStats.GetProperty("inputTokens").GetInt64() == 6 && approvalStats.GetProperty("outputTokens").GetInt64() == 3, "native usage not actual");
await Reject(async () => { await foreach (var _ in approvalPolicy.GetStreamingResponseAsync([..protectedHistory, new(ChatRole.Assistant, "done"), new(ChatRole.User, "another request")], protectedOptions)) { } }, "LIVE_TOOL_INVALID");
Check(approvalProbe.Calls == 3, "unused fourth allowance admitted an invented phase");

foreach (var usage in new UsageDetails?[] {
    null, new() { InputTokenCount = 7 }, new() { OutputTokenCount = 1 },
    new() { InputTokenCount = -1, OutputTokenCount = 1 },
    new() { InputTokenCount = 2, OutputTokenCount = 1, TotalTokenCount = 99 },
    new() { InputTokenCount = 2, OutputTokenCount = 385 }
}) {
    using var usageGate = new FixtureLiveGate("native-approval");
    usageGate.Dispatch();
    if (usage is not null) usageGate.Observe(new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents = [new UsageContent(usage)] });
    usageGate.Finished(false, false);
    var sample = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(usageGate.Snapshot());
    Check(sample.GetProperty("usageCompleteCalls").GetInt32() == 0 && sample.GetProperty("usageIncompleteCalls").GetInt32() == 1, "missing or contradictory native usage labeled complete");
    if (usage?.InputTokenCount == 7) Check(sample.GetProperty("inputTokens").GetInt64() == 7, "known incomplete native usage erased");
}
using (var duplicateUsage = new FixtureLiveGate("native-approval")) {
    duplicateUsage.Dispatch();
    var update = new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents = [new UsageContent(new UsageDetails { InputTokenCount = 2, OutputTokenCount = 1 })] };
    duplicateUsage.Observe(update); duplicateUsage.Observe(update); duplicateUsage.Finished(false, false);
    Check(JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(duplicateUsage.Snapshot()).GetProperty("usageIncompleteCalls").GetInt32() == 1, "duplicate usage accepted");
}

var rejectedProof = new FixtureLiveApprovalProof("catalog-unit");
var rejectedInner = System.Reflection.DispatchProxy.Create<INativeSessionJournal, RejectedLiveJournal>();
var rejectedJournal = new FixtureNativeJournal(rejectedInner, new FixtureNativeGate(""), liveApproval: rejectedProof);
var rejectedLease = new NativeSessionLease(new NativeSessionKey("HashbrownNative", "alice", "unit", new Dictionary<string,string> { ["isolation"] = "alice" }), "owner", 1, 1);
var rejectedCall = new NativeToolCall("unit-call", "lookupAirport", 1, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(protectedArguments));
var rejectedBatch = new NativeApprovalBatch("unit-batch", [new NativeApprovalDescriptor("unit-request", rejectedCall, new NativeRequestLocation("unit-parent", null, 0))], []);
Check(!await rejectedJournal.CaptureModelCallAsync(rejectedLease, rejectedCall), "probe unexpectedly accepted model capture");
Check(!await rejectedJournal.CaptureApprovalBatchAsync(rejectedLease, rejectedBatch), "probe unexpectedly accepted approval capture");
Check(!await rejectedJournal.TryAdmitApprovalBatchAsync(rejectedLease, rejectedBatch.BatchId, new NativeApprovalAdmissionEnvelope("{}", [new NativeApprovalDecision("unit-request", NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Approved)])), "probe unexpectedly admitted");
Check(!await rejectedJournal.TryStartDispatchAsync(rejectedLease, rejectedCall), "probe unexpectedly started");
Check(!await rejectedJournal.CompleteDispatchAsync(rejectedLease, rejectedCall), "probe unexpectedly completed");
Check(await rejectedJournal.SaveAsync(rejectedLease, new NativeSessionSave("{}", "{}", [], [], true)) is null, "probe unexpectedly saved");
var rejectedReceipt = new NativeSavedReceipt(rejectedLease, 2);
Check(!await rejectedJournal.AuthorizePublicationAsync(rejectedReceipt) && !await rejectedJournal.FinalizePublicationAsync(rejectedReceipt), "probe unexpectedly published");
var rejectedSnapshot = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(rejectedProof.Snapshot());
Check(rejectedSnapshot.GetProperty("nativeApprovalCaptures").GetInt32() == 0 && rejectedSnapshot.GetProperty("nativeApprovalAdmissions").GetInt32() == 0 && rejectedSnapshot.GetProperty("nativeApprovalDispatches").GetInt32() == 0 && rejectedSnapshot.GetProperty("nativeApprovalCompletions").GetInt32() == 0 && rejectedSnapshot.GetProperty("nativeApprovalPublications").GetInt32() == 0, "false real-journal responses manufactured successful proof");

Console.WriteLine("Live native fixture passed.");

static void Check(bool value, string message) { if (!value) throw new Exception(message); }
static async Task Reject(Func<Task> action, string code) {
    try { await action(); } catch (Exception error) {
        Check(error.Message == code && error.InnerException is null && !error.ToString().Contains("secret-canary"), "unsafe failure: " + code);
        return;
    }
    throw new Exception("Expected " + code);
}
sealed class ProbeClient : IChatClient {
    public ChatOptions? Options; public int Calls; public int DisposedIterators; public bool Fail;
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        Options = options; Calls++;
        try { await Task.Yield(); if (Fail) throw new Exception("secret-canary", new Exception("secret-canary")); cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); yield return new ChatResponseUpdate(ChatRole.Assistant, "native-text"); }
        finally { DisposedIterators++; }
    }
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
sealed class NativeHandler : HttpMessageHandler {
    public int Calls; public bool StreamDisposed;
    private const string Response = """{"id":"resp_fixture","object":"response","created_at":1720000000,"model":"gpt-4.1-mini","status":"completed","output":[{"type":"message","id":"msg_fixture","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"ok","annotations":[]}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1,"total_tokens":2}}""";
    protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        Calls++;
        using var body = JsonDocument.Parse(await request.Content!.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(cancellationToken));
        if (body.RootElement.TryGetProperty("stream", out var stream) && stream.GetBoolean()) {
            var response = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(Response);
            var message = response.GetProperty("output")[0];
            var part = message.GetProperty("content")[0];
            var events = new List<string>();
            void Emit(string type, object data) {
                var payload = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(data).EnumerateObject().ToDictionary(item => item.Name, item => (object?)item.Value.Clone());
                payload["type"] = type; payload["sequence_number"] = events.Count;
                events.Add($"event: {type}\ndata: {JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload)}\n\n");
            }
            Emit("response.created", new { response = new { id = "resp_fixture", @object = "response", created_at = 1720000000, model = "gpt-4.1-mini", status = "in_progress", output = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.output_item.added", new { output_index = 0, item = new { type = "message", id = "msg_fixture", role = "assistant", status = "in_progress", content = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.content_part.added", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, part = new { type = "output_text", text = "", annotations = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.output_text.delta", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, delta = "ok", logprobs = Array.Empty<object>() });
            Emit("response.output_text.done", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, text = "ok", logprobs = Array.Empty<object>() });
            Emit("response.content_part.done", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, part });
            Emit("response.output_item.done", new { output_index = 0, item = message });
            Emit("response.completed", new { response });
            var content = new StreamContent(new ObservedStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(string.Concat(events)), () => StreamDisposed = true));
            content.Headers.ContentType = new("text/event-stream");
            return new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = content };
        }
        return new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = new StringContent(Response, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
    }
}
sealed class ObservedStream(byte[] bytes, Action disposed) : MemoryStream(bytes) {
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing) { disposed(); base.Dispose(disposing); }
}
sealed class BudgetCredential(Func<int> count) : TokenCredential {
    public int Calls; public bool CountedFirst;
    public override AccessToken GetToken(TokenRequestContext requestContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override ValueTask<AccessToken> GetTokenAsync(TokenRequestContext requestContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        Calls++; CountedFirst = count() == 1;
        return ValueTask.FromException<AccessToken>(new Exception("secret-canary", new Exception("secret-canary")));
    }
}
sealed class DisposeFailureClient : IChatClient, IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate>, IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> {
    public ChatResponseUpdate Current => new(ChatRole.Assistant, "native-text");
    public IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => this;
    public ValueTask<bool> MoveNextAsync() => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => ValueTask.FromException(new Exception("secret-canary"));
    public IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => this;
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
sealed class RedirectLoopback(HttpMessageHandler inner, Uri loopback) : DelegatingHandler(inner) {
    protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        request.RequestUri = new Uri(loopback, request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath);
        return base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
    }
}

sealed class MixedProbe(FunctionCallContent[] calls): IChatClient {
 int count; public ChatOptions? Options;
 public void Dispose(){}
 public object? GetService(Type t, object? key=null)=>null;
 public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> m,ChatOptions? o=null,CancellationToken c=default)=>throw new NotSupportedException();
 public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> m,ChatOptions? o=null,[EnumeratorCancellation]CancellationToken c=default) { await Task.CompletedTask; Options=o; yield return ++count==1 ? new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents=[..calls] } : new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents=[new TextContent("done")] }; }
}


/// <summary>Deterministic native client probe for policy and usage; never a live evidence producer.</summary>
sealed class ApprovalProbe : IChatClient {
    public ChatOptions? Options; public int Calls;
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        await Task.CompletedTask; cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); Options = options; Calls++;
        yield return Calls == 1 ? new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents = [new FunctionCallContent("protected-model-call", "lookupAirport", new Dictionary<string,object?> { ["code"] = "PDX" })] } : new ChatResponseUpdate(ChatRole.Assistant, "done");
        yield return new ChatResponseUpdate { Contents = [new UsageContent(new UsageDetails { InputTokenCount = 2, OutputTokenCount = 1, TotalTokenCount = 3 })] };
    }
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public object? GetService(Type type, object? key = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}

/// <summary>Rejected authority responses demonstrate observation-after-success without manufacturing live evidence.</summary>
public class RejectedLiveJournal : System.Reflection.DispatchProxy {
    protected override object? Invoke(System.Reflection.MethodInfo? method, object?[]? arguments) {
        if (method?.ReturnType == typeof(ValueTask<bool>)) return ValueTask.FromResult(false);
        if (method?.ReturnType == typeof(ValueTask<NativeSavedReceipt>)) return ValueTask.FromResult<NativeSavedReceipt?>(null);
        if (method?.ReturnType == typeof(ValueTask<NativeApprovalEvidence>)) return ValueTask.FromResult<NativeApprovalEvidence?>(null);
        throw new NotSupportedException("unit journal method not configured");
    }
}
